# JP Enterprises public display branding

Scope: the eleven existing published HTML pages in this GitHub Pages site, including the three principal business homepages, the CaptureBrief evidence example, older project pages, the existing project index and the error page.

- Keep each product's own name and design.
- Use JP Enterprises in author metadata and the page footer.
- Use Email JP Enterprises as the default visible contact label on the three principal business homepages.
- Preserve all existing mailto destinations, the buyer's prefilled draft, payment destinations, prices, photographs and product copy.
- Keep cross-project navigation removed from individual business pages; the existing standalone directory is not deleted or newly linked.
- Copy email takes the address from the existing mailto destination, not the branded label. When the browser cannot copy, it reveals and selects the real address for manual copying; it never claims to have sent a message.
- Navigation and email links still work without JavaScript.

This is display branding, not company formation, a trademark clearance, a new mailbox or a change to a payment account. Existing GitHub account information, commit history and mailto destinations are not anonymized or rewritten. No LLC, Inc., registered-trademark mark or other legal-entity claim is added.

Validation: preserve the existing Chromium/WebKit and buyer-journey suites, add a static brand guard for all eleven pages, and include all published HTML in exact-byte deployment verification. Read completed workflow results for the actual verification outcome.
